description: Decodes what a phrase really signals across cultures — the subtext layer of language.
notes: Decodings are curated generalizations — real cultures vary by person and context.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: Cross-cultural implicature is a real source of friction, but 'making hidden social meaning explicit' is a research demo, not a product — and it's exactly what a good LLM prompt already does. $10/mo assumes professionals have a recurring implicature problem they can't solve with ChatGPT. They don't.
